contentPattern.structure: two tab labels, each switching a panel that contains a product-comparison table

suitableFor: simple 2-way (or few-way) toggles that switch between comparable data panels
cover/tier switchers (e.g. Comprehensive vs Third party) each showing a comparison table
compact labeled tab switchers where each panel holds structured data rather than long-form prose
notSuitableFor: long-form rich content panels with headings, images and lists (use tabs-detail)
content that must all be visible at once (use default content / columns)

usage.notes: Car-insurance cover-comparison section (#basic-15950): 'Comprehensive cover' | 'Third party cover' toggle. Each tab panel contains a table-compare comparison table (Platinum/Gold/Admiral/Essential columns x ~18 cover-feature rows).
